from pathlib import Path
base=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-high-fresh0/frozen/held-out-reference-3/play/users/u033/system/state/workspace/programs')
base.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''from collections import deque


def _components(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen = set()
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == 0 or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            q = deque([(r, c)])
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while q:
                x, y = q.popleft()
                cells.append((x, y))
                for nx, ny in ((x-1,y), (x+1,y), (x,y-1), (x,y+1)):
                    if 0 <= nx < h and 0 <= ny < w and (nx, ny) not in seen and grid[nx][ny] == color:
                        seen.add((nx, ny))
                        q.append((nx, ny))
            yield color, cells


def _shape(cells):
    mr = min(r for r, c in cells)
    mc = min(c for r, c in cells)
    return frozenset((r-mr, c-mc) for r, c in cells)


def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    reference_shapes = {_shape(cells) for color, cells in _components(grid) if color == 8}
    for color, cells in _components(grid):
        if color == 1 and _shape(cells) in reference_shapes:
            for r, c in cells:
                out[r][c] = 8
    return out
'''
